correctness.rationale: For Desargues graph P(10,3), a minimum RDF is uniquely determined by T=f^(-1)(2): vertices outside N[T] are forced to label1, all others not in T label0, weight w(T)=2|T|+|V\N[T]|. This characterizes every minimum configuration through exact finite search over all 2^20 subsets. An independently written C++ enumerator constructed adjacency directly, found minimum weight12 and exactly340 optimum functions, and enumerated admissible optimum-preserving P1 2↔0, P2 2↔1, P3 adjacent(1,1)↔(2,0). It independently recovered 540 edges (180 P1, zero P2, 360 P3), 100 isolated vertices and five 48-vertex components, each with 108 edges, radius6 diameter8 and degree multiset 4^42 8^6; global degree multiplicities mobile4:210,mobile8:30 and eccentricity mobile6:30,7:180,8:30. Distinct profile counts (#1,#2) are (0,6):130,(2,5):180,(4,4):30. This finite exhaustive classification, unlike a timeout or sampled search, proves its own finite claim; the 5-cycle automorphism of the mobile components follows by rotating u_i and v_i indices as described.
